sentences.text: Christian Gottlob Neefe -LRB- -LSB- ˈneːfə -RSB- ; 5 February 1748 -- 28 January 1798 -RRB- was a German opera composer and conductor .	opera	opera	composer	composer	conductor	Conducting
Neefe was born in Chemnitz , Saxony .	Chemnitz	Chemnitz	Saxony	Electorate of Saxony
He received a musical education and started to compose at the age of 12 .

He studied law at Leipzig University , but subsequently returned to music to become a pupil of the composer Johann Adam Hiller under whose guidance he wrote his first comic operas .	composer	composer	Leipzig University	Leipzig University	Johann Adam Hiller	Johann Adam Hiller

In 1776 Neefe joined the Seyler theatrical company of Abel Seyler -LRB- then -RRB- in Dresden , and inherited the position of musical director from his mentor , Hiller .	Seyler theatrical company	Seyler theatrical company	Abel Seyler	Abel Seyler
He later became court organist in Bonn and was the principal piano teacher of Ludwig van Beethoven .	Bonn	Bonn	Ludwig van Beethoven	Ludwig van Beethoven
He helped Beethoven produce some of his first works .
His best known work was a Singspiel called Adelheit von Veltheim -LRB- 1780 -RRB- .	Singspiel	Singspiel	Adelheit von Veltheim	Adelheit von Veltheim
In Bonn , Neefe became prefect of the local chapter of the Illuminati , the .	Bonn	Bonn	Illuminati	Illuminati
He died in Dessau .	Dessau	Dessau
